quotes.text: D209891 reviewer questioned calling OpenInternal’s file a folder name: in this path it is the .msf database file. The accepted header names it summaryFile, matching the implementation, while a different OpenMailDBFromFile argument still names the source folder path. The patch also changed the IDL parameter of markMDNSent from bNeeded to bSent. Align declarations and definitions, but choose names from what values mean rather than copying an inaccurate old name. The summaryFile name remains current.
